title: Japanese-Style Mapo Tofu Stir-Fry
description: A Japanese adaptation of the classic Sichuan mapo tofu dish, with a focus on bold flavors and tender tofu.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the intensely roasted chili bean paste, mapo tofu seasoning, soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped chinese chives and serve immediately.
